probing_questions: Which concept, claim or move of the focal text do later texts develop?

analytical_dimensions.description: What the later texts make of it
probing_questions: Which later works take the focal text up as a whole, and in what role: source, foil, framework, courtesy?
What in the focal text does no later text return to?
Read only with what came after: is the focal text the origin of the later agenda, a way-station, or a dead end?

engine_name: The focal text as step one of a journey
problematique: Read the focal text knowing only what the author wrote after it: which of its seeds later texts develop and how, which later works take it up, what in it is never taken up, and whether it is the origin of the later agenda, a way-station, or a dead end. Nothing that came before is in view.
researcher_question: Read as if nothing preceded: what in the focal text is developed later, what is abandoned, and is it an origin?
